content:
DO NOT TIGHTEN THEM ALL THE WAY. At this point I was getting a little ahead of myself and tightened these the entire way before navigating to the next page. I then thought it a good idea to try open the lid and snapped the CORE_One_INDX_hinge_cover_right_r1 piece.

Luckily I also have a CORE One L so I'm reprinting one now in PLA. Hopefully it holds up long enough that I can get/print a proper replacement for it. Don't be me; be patient. Though I'd love to see a warning on this page to not tighten them yet like in previous sections.
Grease the springs with Prusa grease to prevent creaking. Also a t-handle hex wrench with a ball end comes in handy here.
Before placing the top cover, pre-thread the hinge parts. You can rotate them to face outwards to pre-thread, then rotate back.
